dataset.reason: September-2024 v2 fixes the knowledge-conflict issue in the original 3k subset

sampling.order: sample forget first, then retain, using one seeded Python RNG
sampling.flattening: sample instances first; flatten requested_rewrite lists only after sampling

semantic_mapping.mquake_counterfactual_target_new: provenance/evaluation only; never an unlearning target

setting5e.trainable_scope: input embeddings + LM head; transformer frozen by established Setting 5e implementation

method_visible: sampled forget requested_rewrite cloze prompts and target_true answers
sampled retain requested_rewrite cloze prompts and target_true answers
evaluation_only: answer and answer_alias for pre-edit multi-hop leakage
new_answer and new_answer_alias for native editing diagnostic
official multihop standard and CoT prompt files

main_zero_unlearn_compatible.name: Eff
main_zero_unlearn_compatible.definition: teacher-forced original target_true next-token argmax accuracy, atomic-macro percent

main_zero_unlearn_compatible.name: PPL
main_zero_unlearn_compatible.definition: same project official perplexity path used for MCF/ZsRE

held_out_extensions.name: AtomicGen
held_out_extensions.definition: sensitive target_true token accuracy on requested_rewrite.question; never used for repair selection

held_out_extensions.name: MHLeak_exact_any
held_out_extensions.definition: percent of forget instances where any of the three official multi-hop questions exactly recovers the pre-edit answer or alias

held_out_extensions.name: MHLeak_contains_any
held_out_extensions.definition: sensitivity analysis using normalized answer/alias containment

scientific_restrictions: Never use raw MQuAKE target_new as the desired unlearning target
Never use requested_rewrite.question during Setting 5e or active repair
Never use record-level multi-hop questions during Setting 5e, repair, candidate-scale selection, or checkpoint acceptance
Do not call AtomicGen a native ZeroUnlearn MQuAKE metric
Do not call MHLeak a native MQuAKE knowledge-editing metric; label it as the unlearning adaptation of the official multi-hop protocol
Report both number of sampled instances and number of flattened atomic facts
Reject paper claims if the split manifest or dataset SHA is missing
